notes:
USAGE:
{農産物|のうさんぶつ} is a formal compound noun used in news, trade discussions, and policy contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables) or ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧ (fruit) is more common for specific items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧{農産物|のうさんぶつ} (domestic agricultural products)
- ⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧{農産物|のうさんぶつ} (imported agricultural products)
- {農産物|のうさんぶつ}⟦{直売所|ちょくばいじょ}→直売所：13746_chokubaijo⟧ (farm produce direct sales stand)
